home.title: Keep what you learn
home.subtitle: Capture notes, words and rules — then revisit them on a fixed 3, 7 and 30 day rhythm.

home.scheduleSubtitle: Dates are set from the day you learned something. Completing a review never reshuffles the plan.

intervals.three: First revisit — strengthen the fresh trace
intervals.seven: Second revisit — lock the meaning in
intervals.thirty: Third revisit — move it toward lasting recall

home.howSubtitle: Simple flow. No grading. No “I forgot” buttons. Just timely returns to what matters.

1.title: Save what you studied
1.text: Add a topic, definition, Q&A or link right after learning.

2.text: The server schedules reviews for day 3, 7 and 30 automatically.

3.title: Review and mark done
3.text: Open the material, revisit it, press Completed — next dates stay fixed.
